control.detail: No producer. declareInternationalCrisis at international.ts:221 and recordViolenceAttempt at :876 are referenced only by test files, so nothing in a running game can start one.

measuredBy: research queue lane, from lamontae's playtest report

measurements.found: The first three are referenced only by src/presentation/crisis-international.test.ts, src/simulation/crisis/international-persistence.test.ts and international-endings.test.ts. The fourth has two non-test readers. Producer absent, consumer present.
measurements.what: Every reference to declareInternationalCrisis, recordViolenceAttempt, decideInternationalCrisis and pendingInternationalDecisions across src

notes: An assassination or an attempt on anyone is the same shape, through the same recordViolenceAttempt.
playerReachDetail: The player's side is the part that works: the decision panel is fully wired. What is missing is anything that gives them a crisis to decide.

surface.detail: Connected and working. pendingInternationalDecisions is read by src/presentation/crisis-shell.ts:304 and by src/simulation/crisis/notices.ts:642, so a player can be shown a crisis and decide it.

system.detail: A complete chain in src/simulation/crisis/international.ts: declaring a crisis, deciding it, a response, war-powers certification and its extension, and persistence across saves.

title: An international crisis, and therefore any war
